content:
I like how the logic is simple and great for Clash of Code — short, fast, and effective. It helps beginners learn the basics. But I’ve noticed a lot of similar problems in CoC; it’s starting to feel dull. They aren’t identical, but they’re all too familiar — like the standard even/odd exercises. It would be cool to add real-life scenarios to make them more engaging, instead of just plain instructions like ‘count even and odd numbers’.

and for addition, I agree with @User123, to change the "even" and "odd" to <<bold>> if you want to highlight it, instead making it {{constant}}, prolly the "Even" and "Odd" is the only constant as it will shown in Output. I hope this help to refine this work. Thank you!


P.S. No pressure, this are just my feedback.

Please format the *lowercase* "even" and "odd" as <<bold>> instead of using the constants formatting. Formatting them as constants would mean that they appear somewhere in the input/output, which could potentially be confusing.

Thank you!

Hi! This contribution I re-created it because... you can see in this contribution,  https://www.codingame.com/contribute/view/150264e3558813c68ff436a4a958c58faa2cc0
5DN1L have helped me and I thanks him for that 😊.

Glad to help!

Constraints
* Please change 10000 to 100, as it's unusual to have a much wider range of positive values than negative values.

Cases
* Each test and its validator should cover the same scenario. Please revise the cases as follows:

  • Simple Example (test): Please add 0 and -9 to the list.

  • Change "With Negative" to "Simple".

  • Change "Small Numbers" to "Negative Only", and use only random negative integers between -100 and -1 (both even and odd).

  • Change "Big Numbers + Equality" to "Negative", and use only random negative integers between -100 and -1 (both even and odd).

* Please add a new pair of cases where 10 random values between -100 and 100 are used (both even and odd), and some values appear more than once.

Thanks.

A few changes:

Cases
* Negative Odd Numbers (Test 2)

  • Please remove "Odd" from the name.

  • Please add an even integer around -20 to the list *without* modifying the original odd integers.

* All Mixing (Test 5): Please change *both* instances of 21 to -21, keeping their positions unchanged.

* "Difficult" Mixing (Validator 5): Please change 37 to -38.

Thanks.

This point is still outstanding:

* Negative Odd Numbers (Test 2)

  • Please remove "Odd" from the name.

  • Please add an even integer around -20 to the list *without* modifying the original odd integers.

By the way, you said "finished" in the comments above but I didn't see any format change, so I formatted "even" and "odd" in <<bold>> for you.
